title: Email Triage Bot
description: Sorts incoming support email with AI, drafts replies for routine questions, and turns real issues into tickets for the right team.
overview: A Gmail trigger picks up each new email. OpenAI reads it and returns a category (sales, support, billing or other) and a confidence score.

Routine questions get a drafted reply saved in Gmail for a person to check and send. Support issues become Airtable tickets assigned to the matching team. Anything below 70% confidence is flagged for a human instead of being auto-routed.
